selection.policy: Existing audit --since 30d --folder tencent selection by whole-group max file mtime; excludes current parent and all its children; not event-time or successful-task cohort

metricSemantics.requests: Persisted assistant message records, not guaranteed physical request count or unique billed requests.
metricSemantics.cost: Recorded nominal usage.cost.total, not invoice or successful-task cost; failed messages often record zero.
metricSemantics.toolTokens: ceil(returned text.length/4) estimate, not provider tokens; no cost-savings inference.
metricSemantics.repeat: Same returned-text digest for same normalized source in one file, no observed mutator boundary; not proof of avoidability or external state stability.
metricSemantics.workflow: No workflow invocation/receipt marker detected in selected ordinary project histories; dedicated tmp benchmark folders excluded.
metricSemantics.handoff: Only explicit evidence-handoff fence in task.context/user text counted; zero does not rule out freeform or other handoff channels; histories precede reviewed commit.
metricSemantics.verificationCandidates: 15 matching command pairs with no observed mutator; 5 have running acknowledgements in both results, so none are labeled confirmed duplicate successful verification.

manualCases.observation: 11 consecutive credential/API-key validation failures with no intervening user/successful assistant message; 2026-09-21 08:56:58.366Z to 09:10:34.580Z, 13.60 minutes timestamp span; not additive saved time.
Reading remainder used the same artifact://262:raw locator; both results returned lines 1-300 of 340 and the same continuation footer.
Another child repeated the same first page while intending to read the remainder.
Changed offset from 1 to 301 in arguments but kept the same :raw path; both responses remained lines 1-300 of 1808.
Second read intent explicitly rechecks styles for overflow gaps; same bytes is not sufficient to label waste.
Repeated bun check calls returned async.running acknowledgements, not completed validation receipts.

limitations: mtime selects whole groups, not exact 30-day event volume
Versions/models/task difficulty vary; no causal comparison
Snapshot is all pre-9c0f8c743f histories, not a post-fix benefit assessment
No task acceptance labels; no correctness/first-pass/savings estimates
No deduplication of copied history across files or invoice reconciliation
No provider calls or external uploads; classifier usage zero
